description: Does a real ground-floor fire become visible at night while fresh distant smoke detection stops? Keep the prepared open house and add a normal staffed camp with a credible sight route. Observe daytime smoke, sustain the same fire into natural night and quicksave.

forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection

input: frame-bound semantic requests; native overmap special placement is setup only; ordinary ignition, waiting and saving

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Does a real ground-floor fire become visible at night while fresh distant smoke detection stops? Keep the prepared open house and add a normal staffed camp with a credible sight route. Observe daytime smoke, sustain the same fire into natural night and quicksave. Success boundary: Fresh night firelight reaches the eligible observer; fresh night smoke does not. Prior remembered smoke is not fresh detection.
proof_targets: exact standard-open source and working-save identity; current World and source-bound executable
actual ground-floor fire, window geometry, weather and source/receiver positions
setup-only camp placement distinct from normal generated staffing and genuine perception
daytime smoke reception and actual natural-night quicksave with sustained fire
fresh nighttime smoke non-detection and positive firelight reception at an eligible observer, with physical escape/sight evidence
same-run saved continuity, honest failures/limits, game exit and owned helper cleanup
invariants: reference installation and native camp placement are zero-credit preparation; never modify the owner original
no direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection
a physical source or precommitted fixture does not prove knowledge, dispatch or arrival
do not infer observation from absence without an eligible observer and actual source opportunity
do not invent return deadlines or force actor outcome; retain losses and failed observations
disclose source, geometry, date, weather and continuity; distinguish signal emission, receipt and physical travel

catalogue.family_purpose: Compare real smoke and firelight using the prepared open and closed houses.

playtest_recipe.title: Firelight through open windows
playtest_recipe.question: Does a real ground-floor fire become visible at night while fresh distant smoke detection stops?

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Keep the prepared open house and add a normal staffed camp with a credible sight route. Observe daytime smoke, sustain the same fire into natural night and quicksave.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: Fresh night firelight reaches the eligible observer; fresh night smoke does not. Prior remembered smoke is not fresh detection.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
